title: Add the parallel-training reference and its parity table
summary: The training guide names Rudin et al. 2022, the recipe behind RSL-RL, and states this repository's parity with it in six rows: algorithm, batch per update, observations, actions, reward and curriculum. The batch row is the largest gap, 3,072 samples per update against 98,304, with the replica count fixed by the standing admission. The guide changes no setting.
next: Decide whether a larger per-robot rollout enters a future budget before any learner setting changes.
reason: A documentation reference establishes no native result or accepted capability.
